_doc: Central bank speeches read from the banks' OWN sites, for tone the desk may trade on. Adding a bank is adding a row. `terms` is the reuse clause as read on `terms_read`; a row whose terms are not PERMITTED is fetched for research only and its rows are labelled so. The BIS speeches.zip corpus is NOT here: its page says 'Use of the content is allowed for noncommercial purposes', so it stays research-only (side_channels/bis_speech_tone.py).
user_agent: quant-desk-research/1.0 (public central bank speeches; polite, low rate)
